description: This file defines the OpenClawConfigFile enum which manages configuration loading, saving, fingerprinting, and validation for the OpenClaw application. It handles reading and writing JSON configuration files, maintaining metadata, and detecting configuration anomalies with audit logging.

methods.name: url
methods.description: Returns the URL of the configuration file.

methods.name: stateDirURL
methods.description: Returns the URL of the application's state directory.

methods.name: defaultWorkspaceURL
methods.description: Provides the default workspace URL.

methods.name: loadDict
methods.description: Loads and parses the configuration file into a dictionary.

methods.name: saveDict
methods.description: Saves the provided dictionary as the configuration file, with audit logging and anomaly detection.

methods.name: loadGatewayDict
methods.description: Loads the 'gateway' section of the configuration dictionary.

methods.name: updateGatewayDict
methods.description: Updates the 'gateway' section of the configuration with a mutation block, then saves.

methods.name: browserControlEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether browser control is enabled, defaulting to true.

methods.name: setBrowserControlEnabled
methods.description: Sets whether browser control is enabled.

methods.name: agentWorkspace
methods.description: Retrieves the agent workspace from configuration.

methods.name: setAgentWorkspace
methods.description: Sets the agent workspace in configuration.

methods.name: gatewayPassword
methods.description: Retrieves the password for the gateway, if set.

methods.name: gatewayPort
methods.description: Retrieves the gateway port if specified.

methods.name: remoteGatewayPort
methods.description: Retrieves the remote gateway port if available.

methods.name: remoteGatewayPort(matchingHost:)
methods.description: Retrieves the remote gateway port if the host matches.

methods.name: setRemoteGatewayUrl
methods.description: Sets the remote gateway URL with specified host and port.

methods.name: clearRemoteGatewayUrl
methods.description: Removes the remote gateway URL setting.

methods.name: hostKey
methods.description: Generates a normalized key for a host, for comparison purposes.

methods.name: parseConfigData
methods.description: Parses raw Data into a config dictionary, supporting JSON5 if available.

methods.name: stampMeta
methods.description: Adds version and timestamp metadata to the configuration dictionary.

methods.name: hasMeta
methods.description: Checks if the configuration has metadata.

methods.name: gatewayMode
methods.description: Retrieves the gateway mode from the configuration.

methods.name: configWriteSuspiciousReasons
methods.description: Detects reasons why a config write might be suspicious, such as size drops or missing metadata.

methods.name: configAuditLogURL
methods.description: Returns the URL for config audit logs.

methods.name: configHealthStateURL
methods.description: Returns the URL for config health state logs.

methods.name: readConfigHealthState
methods.description: Reads the current health state of configuration from logs.

methods.name: writeConfigHealthState
methods.description: Saves the current health state of configuration.

methods.name: configHealthEntry
methods.description: Retrieves the health entry for a specific config path.

methods.name: setConfigHealthEntry
methods.description: Sets the health entry for a specific config path.

methods.name: isUpdateChannelOnlyRoot
methods.description: Checks if the root config contains only an update channel.

methods.name: fileTimestampMs
methods.description: Converts a file attribute date to milliseconds.

methods.name: fileAttributeInt
methods.description: Converts a file attribute to Int, if possible.

methods.name: fileSystemNumber
methods.description: Converts a file attribute to a string representation of the number.

methods.name: posixMode
methods.description: Extracts the POSIX permission bits from a mode value.

methods.name: configFingerprint
methods.description: Computes a fingerprint of a configuration file, including hash, size, timestamps, and metadata.

methods.name: sameFingerprint
methods.description: Determines if two fingerprints are identical.

methods.name: observeSuspiciousReasons
methods.description: Analyzes config differences for suspicious anomalies like size drops or missing metadata.

methods.name: readConfigFingerprint
methods.description: Reads and fingerprints the config file at given URL.

methods.name: configTimestampToken
methods.description: Converts a timestamp string into a filename-safe token.

methods.name: persistClobberedSnapshot
methods.description: Saves a snapshot of a config data when manipulation is detected.

methods.name: observeConfigRead
methods.description: Performs analysis after reading a config file to detect anomalies, logs, and updates health status.

methods.name: appendConfigWriteAudit
methods.description: Logs a config write event with details for audit.

methods.name: appendConfigObserveAudit
methods.description: Logs a config observe event with detailed analysis results.
